narrative.intro: Granite Construction has $607M in contract obligations in FY2026 to date. All figures are contract obligations except award-value figures in the largest-awards and expiring-contracts tables, which are total contract values. Granite Construction won 14 awards this fiscal year with an average award size of $43.4M, and obligations are up 152.6% year over year. Obligations have grown from $20.3M in FY21 and $19.7M in FY22 to $335M in FY23, $185M in FY24, $240M in FY25, and $607M in FY26. Department of Homeland Security is the largest buyer for Granite Construction at $545M, followed by Department of Transportation at $35.9M and Department of Defense at $26.7M. Commercial and Institutional Building Construction is the largest market for Granite Construction at $545M, followed by Highway, Street, and Bridge Construction at $35.9M and Other Heavy and Civil Engineering Construction at $26.4M. Granite Construction also has obligations in Asphalt Paving Mixture and Block Manufacturing at $250K. This profile summarizes current-year obligations and the agency and market concentration of federal work.

sections.heading: Who are Granite Construction's top federal buyers?
sections.body: Department of Homeland Security is Granite Construction's top buyer with $545M in obligations. Department of Transportation follows with $35.9M. Department of Defense is a smaller buyer at $26.7M.

sections.heading: What federal markets drive Granite Construction's obligations?
sections.body: Commercial and Institutional Building Construction is Granite Construction's largest market at $545M. Highway, Street, and Bridge Construction and Other Heavy and Civil Engineering Construction follow with $35.9M and $26.4M respectively. Granite Construction also has $250K in Asphalt Paving Mixture and Block Manufacturing obligations.

faq.q: How much does Granite Construction make from federal contracts?
faq.a: Granite Construction has received $607M in contract obligations in FY2026 to date. Granite Construction won 14 awards this fiscal year with an average award size of $43.4M, and obligations are up 152.6% year over year.

faq.q: Which agencies buy from Granite Construction?
faq.a: Department of Homeland Security, Department of Transportation, and Department of Defense buy from Granite Construction. Department of Homeland Security accounts for $545M, Department of Transportation accounts for $35.9M, and Department of Defense accounts for $26.7M.

faq.q: What does Granite Construction sell to the government?
faq.a: Granite Construction sells construction services to the government, concentrated in Commercial and Institutional Building Construction at $545M. Granite Construction also sells services in Highway, Street, and Bridge Construction at $35.9M, Other Heavy and Civil Engineering Construction at $26.4M, and Asphalt Paving Mixture and Block Manufacturing at $250K.
